title: Cider Braised Chinese Pork Potstickers
description: A comforting, post-workout dish featuring braised pork in a flavorful cider sauce, all wrapped up in delicate potstickers.
instructions: In a copper pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the ground pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cider vinegar, soy sauce, and scallions to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened slightly.
Meanwhile, prepare the wonton wrappers according to the package instructions.
To assemble the potstickers, lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a small spoonful of the pork filling in the center.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the potsticker.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Add the potstickers to the copper pot and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the filling is heated through.
Serve the potstickers hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
